_doc: Frozen single-endpoint SQuAD product-semantics contract. The host may contain two GPUs, but every command below activates only endpoint 8000 / GPU 0. This file must never be cited as a dual-GPU or multi-endpoint method experiment. Fields marked REPLACE_ME must be filled and the service hash recomputed before a formal single-endpoint run.

topology.note: With one endpoint, project per-endpoint admission equals global admission and cross-endpoint routing is absent. Project_static is only a correctness/pipeline-overhead diagnostic in this track.

duckdb_extension.note: The DuckDB ai community extension owns batching/concurrency/retry/cache. The runner supplies one BASE_URL and injects no project credit, actor pool, cross-endpoint sharding, or dynamic backpressure.

project_static.note: The runner requires explicit static values. The timing boundary and same-signature token-budget calibration remain unresolved; independently, one endpoint cannot exercise the project's endpoint-aware method.

service.env_snapshot: REPLACE_ME: CUDA / driver / OS snapshot ref
service.vllm_config_hash: REPLACE_ME: sha256[:16] over the active single-endpoint service fields above

duckdb_ai_command_template: python code/scripts/baselines/squad_database_e2e_runner.py --arm duckdb_ai --database-url $DATABASE_URL --workload-name squad_v11_dev_short_answer --importer-provenance feasibility/results/squad_v11_dev_import_20260805/provenance.json --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions --metrics-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics --model qwen2.5-7b --max-tokens 64 --max-concurrent-requests 32 --service-prefix-caching enabled --service-config-hash <vllm_config_hash> --metrics-settle-s 5 --strict-attribution --writeback-mode json_text --write-batch-rows 500 --output-dir feasibility/results/squad_database_e2e_duckdb_ai_REPLACE_ME --force
direct_client_command_template: python code/scripts/baselines/squad_database_e2e_runner.py --arm direct_client --database-url $DATABASE_URL --workload-name squad_v11_dev_short_answer --importer-provenance feasibility/results/squad_v11_dev_import_20260805/provenance.json --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions --metrics-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics --model qwen2.5-7b --max-tokens 64 --max-concurrent-requests 32 --service-prefix-caching enabled --service-config-hash <vllm_config_hash> --metrics-settle-s 5 --strict-attribution --writeback-mode json_text --write-batch-rows 500 --output-dir feasibility/results/squad_database_e2e_direct_client_REPLACE_ME --force
project_gate_command_template: python code/scripts/baselines/squad_database_e2e_runner.py --arm project_static --database-url $DATABASE_URL --workload-name squad_v11_dev_short_answer --importer-provenance feasibility/results/squad_v11_dev_import_20260805/provenance.json --endpoint-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions --metrics-url http://127.0.0.1:8000/metrics --model qwen2.5-7b --max-tokens 64 --token-budget <same_signature_calibrated_value> --project-max-inflight 8 --project-max-active-work-per-endpoint 65536 --project-actor-workers 8 --project-ray-actor-max-concurrency 1 --project-python /root/miniconda3/bin/python --service-prefix-caching enabled --service-config-hash <vllm_config_hash> --metrics-settle-s 5 --strict-attribution --writeback-mode json_text --write-batch-rows 500 --limit 256 --output-dir feasibility/results/squad_database_e2e_project_static_gate_REPLACE_ME --force

ranking_contract.note: This is a single-endpoint product-semantics track, not a dual-GPU method ranking. Project_static remains diagnostic until both the unified timing boundary and same-signature calibration are archived, and it can never support a multi-endpoint method claim in this runner.
